$comment: The CI gate is USER-CHOSEN, not 'every screen automatically'. Each entry in `screens` is a
screen whose whole spec/<screen>/test.spec.ts runs in the GitHub Actions e2e gate (tools/ci-select.mjs
resolves this file into the exact `playwright test` file list; see .github/workflows/e2e.yml).
`dispatch` is deliberately excluded: its spec drives nested recorded runs against the board's
own job-slot machinery (a run started by a run, cancel targeting), which is slow and flaky on a
shared CI runner — not a screen the human wants gating merges. Edit this list freely as screens
are added, retired, or judged too slow/flaky for the gate; a screen left out still runs fine
locally with `npm run e2e`. If this file is absent entirely, the resolver falls back to every
screen on disk — deleting it does not disable the gate, it just widens it back to 'all'.
